{{Top|leg}}
A '''stasis booth''' was a coffin-like container with a dedicated power generator that produced an [[Entropy field/Legends|entropy field]], causing a person's life functions to be suspended. While in a stasis booth, the subject would not age or change in any way, nor would they be aware of their surroundings. Stasis booths were used extensively at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] to store extremely dangerous criminals - with their use being proposed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] as an effective, though costly, way of detaining [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals.
